svg.title: Automated Incident Response Network
svg.desc: Complete architecture with Multi-AZ, internal resources in private subnet, corrected flow log direction, attack path through IGW, and Lambda kill switch on NACL.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does CloudWatch collect VPC Flow Logs?')
sendPrompt('How does GuardDuty detect SSH brute force?')
sendPrompt('How does EventBridge route findings to Lambda?')
sendPrompt('What does Lambda do when triggered?')
sendPrompt('How does the NACL shield the public subnet?')
sendPrompt('Why is port 22 open on the honeypot?')
sendPrompt('What internal resources live in the private subnet?')
sendPrompt('Why is the database in the private subnet?')
sendPrompt('What other resources are in the private subnet?')
sendPrompt('Does AZ-B also have a Network ACL?')
sendPrompt('What runs in the AZ-B public subnet?')
sendPrompt('What internal resources are in AZ-B?')
sendPrompt('Why replicate the database to AZ-B?')
sendPrompt('What other resources are replicated in AZ-B?')
sendPrompt('What attack patterns does the honeypot attract?')
